name: Firehorse sections
note: The map from a data kind to the Firehorse section that shows it. An agent looks the kind up and uses the section it names; a kind with no entry is a Firehorse gap. Every section is the shell (fh-panel-section) plus a kind modifier. Docs: https://firehorse.rascode.dev/components/sections/

sidecar.chips: One chip row in the header: the record's state, in at most four chips. Chips appear nowhere else in the body, except one status chip a row may carry (a log line level, a prompt state).

shell.icon: Required, first. An fh-icon with class fh-panel-section__icon; the section's tone colours it.
shell.title: An h3 with class fh-panel-section__title. Larger than body text, in the strongest text role.
shell.collapse: The summary is the control. Open by default unless the kind says otherwise.
shell.chips: In fh-panel-section__chips inside the summary. Shown only while collapsed. A row in the body may carry one status chip (fh-chip fh-chip--tone fh-chip--sm with a status tone), for status only: a log line level, a prompt state. No other chips in rows.

css.metrics: firehorse.css (fh-metric is in the core bundle)

chips.rule: The two or three values that matter most (status, owner, duration).

slots: rows; every reference in a cell is a link that opens that record's sidecar

chips.rule: The record count, then the count that needs attention.
The step count and the span, first time to last.
The event count and the time of the last event.
The message count and the time of the last one.

slots: level (the row status chip, toned by data-tone on the row)

chips.rule: The line count and the count of warnings or errors, if any.

prompts.body: fh-prompts > li > a.fh-prompt (fh-prompt__key, fh-prompt__version, status chip, fh-prompt__meta)

chips.rule: The prompt count and the dispatch they belong to.
The headline figures, as value and unit.

slots: link that opens the record's sidecar

chips.rule: The file count and the total size.
